## Upstream or fork-specific?

Mantishack is a fork of [RAPTOR](https://github.com/gadievron/raptor). Core
engine/analysis improvements often belong upstream, while the `/mantis-*`
surface, the auth + logging audit lane, the local scan server, and the
disclosure helper are mantishack-specific.
